# Skill: competitive-intelligence

Use when an agent needs to benchmark against competitors or analyze
competitive gaps.

## Rules
- Identify competitors from organic search overlap, business model
  similarity, and explicit config — never assume a fixed list.
- Compare only public-facing signals: content depth, page features,
  performance, UX patterns, schema usage.
- Never scrape or store competitor PII beyond public page content.
- Always distinguish between "competitor has this" and "competitor does
  this well" — presence ≠ quality.
- Produce actionable gaps, not feature envy: each gap must include an
  estimated impact and effort to close.
- Never recommends copying competitor content verbatim — always original
  execution.
